policy.purpose: League-specific context adjustments for Champions before VOR is calculated.
policy.guardrail: Use only for verified role, injury, trade, legal, suspension, rookie, or depth-chart changes. Keep analyst opinion advisory and visible.
policy.refresh_note: Run the backend refresh after edits so VOR and public/champions.json both reflect the context layer.

overrides.name: Josh Allen
overrides.note: Superflex ECR has Allen at the top of the board and CBS treats him as a standalone QB tier. Slightly elevate QB scarcity without forcing every QB up.

sources.label: CBS Jamey Eisenberg QB tiers, Aug 2026

overrides.name: D.J. Moore
overrides.note: Buffalo gives Moore a real WR1 path with Josh Allen, but the prior-year efficiency flags keep this to a moderate boost.

overrides.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
overrides.note: New Orleans role and expected volume support a bump, but Kamara overlap and per-touch concerns keep the boost restrained.

overrides.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
overrides.note: Replace the stale Darnell Mooney mimic with a stable WR2/3 baseline, then add a small target-vacancy bump. Still needs discount because the injury recovery was uneven.

overrides.name: MarShawn Lloyd
overrides.note: Jacobs being unavailable creates a draftable Lloyd role, but committee and sample-size risk keep him below a locked-in starting RB baseline.

sources.label: CBS Jamey Eisenberg RB tiers, Aug 2026

overrides.name: Josh Jacobs
overrides.note: Currently not eligible to practice or play while on the exempt list. Treat as a discount-only stash until the NFL gives a clearer return path.

overrides.name: Puka Nacua
overrides.note: Do not auto-fade a true elite WR, but keep him visually flagged because any late groin or discipline risk changes the Allen/Puka decision fast.
